The oauth gem is required transitively by jira-ruby, so the code is reachable when the Jira integration is used. The fix needs a major bump, 0.5.6 to 1.1.6, which jira-ruby does not declare support for, and the version constraint comes from GitLab (gitlab-foss). Resolves when GitLab bumps the dependency.

Fix is in oauth 1.1.6. GitLab does not declare oauth directly; it is pulled in by jira-ruby 2.3.0, which pins "oauth (~> 0.5, >= 0.5.0)" and therefore caps the gem below the 1.x line. Reaching 1.1.6 is a major-version bump that also requires an upstream jira-ruby dependency change, so the upgrade risk is not being taken here. Reachability of the cross-origin token-request redirect path through GitLab's Jira integration is still being assessed.
